1_algorithm.result: PASS (mechanical) / official text with the weight table NOT located
1_algorithm.official_anchor: DIAN's own NIT 800.197.268-4, published on dian.gov.co (e.g. https://www.dian.gov.co/tramitesservicios/Tramites_Impuestos/RUT/Paginas/default.aspx) and normograma.dian.gov.co: the same algorithm gives sum 733, mod 11 = 7, DV = 11-7 = 4, which matches the official DV.
1_algorithm.official_references_without_formula: DIAN Oficio 909585 (063) of 2021, https://normograma.dian.gov.co/dian/compilacion/docs/oficio_dian_909585_2021.htm: says the DV is part of the electronic-invoicing technical validation and cites Orden Administrativa 001 de 2005 and Anexo Tecnico FE v1.8, but does not set out the weights.
1_algorithm.secondary_quote: Take the NIT digits from right to left and multiply them by 3, 7, 13, 17, 19, 23, 29, 37, 41, 43, 47, 53, 59, 67, 71; sum; remainder mod 11: if 0 or 1 that is the DV, otherwise DV = 11 - remainder (siemprealdia.co, paraphrase of the Spanish text)
1_algorithm.note: A dian.gov.co/gov.co page that states the weight vector itself was not found in this session. The map 'source' line should not present the algorithm as quoted from a DIAN publication. Under the rule 'no proof, leave it out', the correction stands on the mechanical match with DIAN's own published NIT/DV, not on a quoted DIAN text.
